title: Refill Log
content: Refill Log is your central hub for all LN2 top-up activity — pending detections, confirmed history, active tank status, and reservoir inventory across every branch.

title: Open Refill Log
content: Click here to open the Refill Log page.

title: Refill Detected
content: The system uses sensor data to automatically detect when a container has been refilled. Each card here is a pending detection — review it and add it as a confirmed log, or dismiss it if the reading is inaccurate.

title: Detection Card
content: Container T-161 in Bangalore was detected as refilled on 21 Apr 2026 at 08:15 AM — 5.2 kg of LN2 added. Click Add Log to convert this detection into a confirmed refill record.

title: Add Log
content: Click Add Log to open the confirmation form for this detection.

title: Add Log Form
content: The form is pre-filled with data from the detection — tank T-161, Bangalore reservoir, date, time, and 5.2 kg refill weight. Select who performed the refill and add any relevant notes before saving.

title: Save the Log
content: Click Save to confirm this refill and add it to the activity log.

title: Recent Activity Log
content: Every confirmed refill is listed here — who performed it, when, how much LN2 was added, and any notes attached. This is your full audit trail for compliance and maintenance reviews.

title: Active Tank Status
content: All active containers and their current LN2 levels are listed here. Tanks approaching the minimum threshold are flagged so you can schedule a refill before a critical alert fires.

title: Tank T-11 — Tambaram
content: Each row shows the container code, branch, current LN2 level against the L2 threshold, and days since the last refill. Click View to inspect the full refill history for this container.

title: View Refill History
content: Click View to open the refill history for tank T-11.

title: Refill History
content: The complete refill log for this container is shown here — last refill date, who performed it, quantity added, reservoir used, and current status. Use this for audit and maintenance tracking.

title: Close
content: Click Close to dismiss the history panel and return to the main view.

title: Reservoir Logs
content: Reservoir Logs tracks bulk LN2 orders and deliveries for each branch. Both the order date and the received date are recorded to keep your supply chain transparent and auditable.

title: Bangalore Reservoir
content: This entry shows an LN2 order placed on 20 Apr 2026 for the Bangalore Reservoir — but the received date is still missing. You'll need to update it once the delivery arrives to keep the record complete.

title: Edit Reservoir Log
content: Click the edit icon to fill in the missing received date for this order.

title: LN2 Received Date
content: The received date has been pre-filled as 2026-04-25. Completing this field closes the gap in the order record and keeps your reservoir inventory accurate.

title: Save
content: Click Save to record the received date and update the Bangalore Reservoir log.

title: Reservoir Logs
content: The Bangalore Reservoir log is now complete. Every bulk LN2 order and delivery across all branches is tracked here — a fully auditable supply chain record.

title: Reservoir Tank Visualizer
content: This visualizer shows the current LN2 fill level for the selected branch reservoir. Use the dropdown below to switch between branches and monitor each reservoir at a glance.

title: Switch Reservoir
content: Use the branch selector below the tank to switch reservoirs and check a different location's LN2 level.

title: Select Delhi
content: All branch reservoirs are listed here. Click Delhi to load its current LN2 level into the visualizer.

title: Delhi Reservoir
content: Delhi Reservoir is at 62% — 154.4 kg of LN2 out of a 250 kg maximum. Keep an eye on this panel to catch levels nearing the threshold before a critical alert fires.
